description.value: Wild Thyme brings authentic Lebanese cuisine to New Westminster's 12th Street corridor, anchored by handmade flatbreads baked in an imported brick oven and a signature za'atar spice blend. The menu spans traditional dishes like Moudammas, fattoush salad, and lamb shank, earning strong local praise for generous portions and flavours rarely found elsewhere in Metro Vancouver. The restaurant cultivates a warm, family-oriented dining room with a focus on seasonal and imported ingredients.

address.value: 705 Twelfth Street, New Westminster, BC V3M 4J7
